properties.sfomuseum:description: Handwritten letter from Harold M. Bixby to his wife, Debby Bixby, dated Monday, October 9, 1933; update on new concessions required by the minister of communications [Chu Chia-hua]; includes description of meeting with Mr. Chu, Mr. Wei I-fu, and Dai [Enki] to negotiate a provisional operating agreement; personal and family matters; mentions Bob [Robert] Gast, Ed [Eddie] Smith.
